info.schedule: First Tuesday, May through September, Rome
info.note: Weekly legal ads are archived for every sale month. They list parcels and owners but not amounts owed or results.

auction.venue: Backside of the Floyd County Courthouse
auction.time: First Tuesday of the sale month, 10:00 am to 4:00 pm
auction.payment: Cash or certified funds. At the Tax Commissioner's discretion, payment is required within two hours of the completion of the sale.
auction.office_address: 5 Government Plaza, Suite 109, Rome, GA 30161 (mailing: P.O. Box 26, Rome, GA 30162)
vital: Buyer beware sale. All property is sold as is with no warranty of title and subject to recorded covenants, easements and rights of way.
Property is sold under a tax sale deed with specific rights of redemption.
The purchaser pays for title, all transfer costs, all taxes, advertising costs and recording fees.
Property inside the City of Rome is sold subject to city taxes.
The weekly legal ad files posted on the Tax Sales page list each parcel, owner, deed reference and years due.

Georgia law: the owner or any lienholder may redeem for 12 months after the sale, and until the right to redeem is foreclosed, by paying the bid plus a 20% premium, plus 10% for each additional year (O.C.G.A. 48-4-40 to 48-4-45).
auction.next_dates: None. All regularly scheduled 2026 sales are complete; the county says to check back for 2027 sales.
auction.confirmed: Checked 2026-10-03. Venue and terms from the September 1, 2026 sale ad (file posted 2026-09-03). No bidder registration procedure is published.
